entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen, I'd like to make a return. I bought a pair of spin class shoes a little while ago and they just aren't working out for me.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I think I got them about 45 days ago, maybe a little more. I hope that's not a problem.
Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. And **no problem** at all! Our return policy is for **10 days** from the delivery date, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Oh, 10 days? That's great! I was worried I had waited too long.
Not at all. I've just initiated the process for you. I'm sending the pre-paid **return label** to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow, that was fast. Thank you.
Of course. And I see here you're a VIP member with VeloFit. To thank you for your business, would you mind if I added a 20% off coupon to your account for your next purchase?
Really? That would be fantastic! You've been a great help, Karen.
It's my pleasure. The coupon is now active on your account, and the return label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
